sources.title: MiMo-V2.6 | Xiaomi
sources.snippet: Today, we are releasing and open-sourcing the MiMo-V2.6 series. This marks a key step in our exploration of the RSI path: scaling RL compute on verifiable, complex tasks, so the model can continuously expand its capability frontier through exploration and feedback. sources.title: Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6: Pro, Flash MoE + Distill-9B same-day drop
sources.snippet: Xiaomi MiMo published the MiMo-V2.6 series on September 21, 2026 — not a single checkpoint, but a same-day stack: open-weight Pro-RL and Flash-RL MoE models on Hugging Face, a separate 9B Qwen distill for agentic RL research, plus API SKUs on mimo.mi.com that include a latency-priced Pro-UltraSpeed tier.
